title: Conducting an MRC Projection
text: create_projection_object() assembles projection settings object. variants_loader() checks country list projection settings mutually consistent (particular post_switch flags match) prints summary active settings returning validated object. must called project(). projection requires country list. run second scenario (e.g. no_diff = TRUE), call create_country_list() creating second projection object.
code: obj <- variants_loader(create_projection_object(   "my_projection", # unique name; also used as the default output folder name    cl, # country list created with create_country_list()   steps = 11L, # number of 5-year periods to project   # (11 steps covers 2020–2075 with a 2020 base year)    migration = TRUE, # include migration flows (emigration and immigration)    switching = TRUE, # include religious switching   switching_type = 1L, # switching sequence:   #   1 = switching before mortality in each half-step   #   2 = mortality before switching    light_migration = TRUE, # **recommended** — store migration flows as period   # totals rather than full age–sex breakdowns.   # Full breakdowns increase output size by ~10× and   # are rarely needed for a full 11-step projection.    light_switching = TRUE, # **recommended** — store switching flows as period   # totals for the same reason.    no_diff = FALSE, # FALSE = use religion-specific fertility differentials   # TRUE  = all religions share the same aggregate ASFR    post_switch = FALSE # used in the MRC report; recommended when only the   # current religious affiliation (not origin) is needed.   # Must match the post_switch setting of the country list. )) cl2 <- create_country_list(post_switch = FALSE, progress_bar = FALSE)  obj2 <- variants_loader(create_projection_object(   "nodiff", cl2,   steps = 11L, migration = TRUE,   switching = TRUE, switching_type = 1L,   light_migration = TRUE, light_switching = TRUE,   no_diff = TRUE, # uniform fertility — no religion-specific differentials   post_switch = FALSE ))

title: Inner Workings
text: Calculate max factor — set initial upper bound max_factor = 1 / max(pattern), ensures scaled pattern exceed 1 entry. Set factor = max_factor / 2 — start binary search midpoint. Set minimum factor = 0 — initialise lower bound. Create factored vector — multiply pattern current factor. Check retention condition (loop, 1 000 iterations): prod(1 − factored_vector) > retention? TRUE — product survival probabilities exceeds required retention rate, meaning switching-probability low. Set factor = min_retention recompute factored vector. FALSE — product required retention rate. Set factor = max_retention recompute. iteration loop rechecks condition. condition satisfied stably (1 000 iterations) loop exits. Return 1 − factored_vector — complement factored switching pattern gives final retention probability religion age–sex group. value becomes diagonal entry switching transition matrix; -diagonal entries derived factored pattern.
